// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/ 
//@version=6
indicator("QuantLux - Breakout Scalper (XAUUSD)", 
         overlay=true, 
         max_boxes_count=500, 
         max_lines_count=500, 
         max_labels_count=500)

// ==================== USER INPUTS ====================
// Daily Trade Plot
triggerTimeInput = input.string("07:00", "Trigger Time (UTC+1)", group="Daily Trade Plot", tooltip="Format: HH:MM (e.g. 07:00) for daily zones")
enable2HourPlot = input.bool(true, "Plot Every 2 Hours", group="Daily Trade Plot", tooltip="Enable to plot zones every 2 hours instead of once daily")

// Internal Settings
extensionMinutes = 10

// Box Settings
boxHeight = input.float(10.0, "Gray Box Height", minval=1.0, step=0.5, tooltip="Height of the central gray box")
showGrayBox = input.bool(true, "Show Gray Box")
grayBoxColor = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 70), "Gray Box Color")

// Spacing Settings
stopLineBuffer = input.float(3.0, "Buffer: Gray Box to Stop Lines", minval=0.0, step=0.5, tooltip="Space between gray box border and dashed stop lines")
stopToTPGap = input.float(5.0, "Gap: Stop Lines to TP Lines", minval=0.0, step=0.5, tooltip="Space between dashed stop lines and first TP line")
tpLineGap = input.float(6.0, "Gap Between TP Lines", minval=0.0, step=0.5, tooltip="Vertical space between each TP line")

// Dashed Lines
showDashedLines = input.bool(true, "Show Dashed Lines (Buy/Sell Stop)")
dashedLineColor = input.color(color.black, "Dashed Line Color")
dashedLineWidth = input.int(1, "Dashed Line Width", minval=1, maxval=5)

// TP Settings
showTPZones = input.bool(true, "Show TP Lines")
tpLineWidth = input.int(1, "TP Line Width", minval=1, maxval=5)
tpLineColorUp = input.color(#26a69a, "TP Up Color")
tpLineColorDn = input.color(#b71c1c, "TP Down Color")

// Bar Color Settings
showTriggerBar = input.bool(true, "Color Trigger Bar", group="Bar Color Settings")
triggerBarColor = input.color(color.black, "Trigger Bar Color", group="Bar Color Settings", tooltip="Color of the bar that triggers the zone plotting")

// Label Settings
showLabels = input.bool(true, "Show Labels")
labelSize = input.string("normal", "Label Size", options=["tiny", "small", "normal", "large", "huge"])
tpTextColor = input.color(color.black, "TP Label Text Color", tooltip="Color for the TP label text")

// Alert Settings
enableAlerts = input.bool(true, "Enable Alerts", tooltip="Alert when price closes above Buy Stop or below Sell Stop")

// ==================== PARSE TRIGGER TIME ====================
timeParts = str.split(triggerTimeInput, ":")
triggerHour = array.size(timeParts) > 0 ? math.max(0, math.min(23, nz(str.tonumber(array.get(timeParts, 0)), 7))) : 7
triggerMinute = array.size(timeParts) > 1 ? math.max(0, math.min(59, nz(str.tonumber(array.get(timeParts, 1)), 0))) : 0

// ==================== HELPER FUNCTIONS ====================
getLabelSize(sizeStr) =>
    switch sizeStr
        "tiny" => size.tiny
        "small" => size.small
        "normal" => size.normal
        "large" => size.large
        "huge" => size.huge
        => size.large

// ==================== STORAGE ARRAYS ====================
var box[] grayBoxes = array.new<box>()
var line[] buyStopLines = array.new<line>()
var line[] sellStopLines = array.new<line>()
var label[] buyStopLabels = array.new<label>()
var label[] sellStopLabels = array.new<label>()

var line[] tp1UpLines = array.new<line>()
var line[] tp1DnLines = array.new<line>()
var line[] tp2UpLines = array.new<line>()
var line[] tp2DnLines = array.new<line>()
var line[] tp3UpLines = array.new<line>()
var line[] tp3DnLines = array.new<line>()

var label[] tp1UpLabels = array.new<label>()
var label[] tp1DnLabels = array.new<label>()
var label[] tp2UpLabels = array.new<label>()
var label[] tp2DnLabels = array.new<label>()
var label[] tp3UpLabels = array.new<label>()
var label[] tp3DnLabels = array.new<label>()

// ==================== DETECT TRIGGER TIME ====================
// Get time in GMT+1 timezone
currentTime = time + 3600000  // Add 1 hour in milliseconds for UTC+1
currentHour = hour(currentTime)
currentMinute = minute(currentTime)
currentDay = dayofmonth(currentTime)

// Track last trigger to avoid duplicates
var int lastTriggerTime = na

// Declare buyStop and sellStop variables
float buyStop = na
float sellStop = na

// Determine trigger condition based on mode
isTriggerBar = false
if enable2HourPlot
    // Trigger every 2 hours at minute 0
    isTriggerBar := (currentMinute == 0 and currentHour % 2 == 0)
else
    // Trigger once daily at specified hour
    isTriggerBar := (currentHour == triggerHour and currentMinute == triggerMinute)

// Check if we should trigger (avoid duplicates)
shouldTrigger = false
if enable2HourPlot
    // For 2-hour mode, check if 2 hours have passed
    if na(lastTriggerTime) or (currentTime - lastTriggerTime) >= 7200000  // 2 hours in milliseconds
        shouldTrigger := isTriggerBar
else
    // For daily mode, check if it's a different day
    shouldTrigger := isTriggerBar and currentDay != dayofmonth(lastTriggerTime)

// Color the trigger bar
barcolor(showTriggerBar and shouldTrigger ? triggerBarColor : na, title="Trigger Bar Color")

if shouldTrigger
    lastTriggerTime := currentTime
    
    // Reference price from current candle close
    refPrice = close
    
    // Calculate bar indices for extension
    leftBar = bar_index - extensionMinutes
    rightBar = bar_index + extensionMinutes
    
    // Calculate gray box borders
    halfBoxHeight = boxHeight / 2
    grayBoxTop = refPrice + halfBoxHeight
    grayBoxBottom = refPrice - halfBoxHeight
    
    // Calculate Buy/Sell Stop lines (with buffer from gray box)
    buyStop := grayBoxTop + stopLineBuffer
    sellStop := grayBoxBottom - stopLineBuffer
    
    // ========== GRAY BOX ==========
    if showGrayBox
        grayBox = box.new(left=leftBar, right=rightBar, 
                         top=grayBoxTop, bottom=grayBoxBottom,
                         xloc=xloc.bar_index, 
                         bgcolor=grayBoxColor,
                         border_color=color.new(color.gray, 50),
                         border_width=1)
        array.push(grayBoxes, grayBox)
    
    // ========== DASHED LINES ==========
    if showDashedLines
        // Buy Stop Line (above gray box)
        buyStopLine = line.new(x1=leftBar, y1=buyStop, x2=rightBar, y2=buyStop,
                               xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=dashedLineColor, 
                               width=dashedLineWidth, style=line.style_dashed)
        array.push(buyStopLines, buyStopLine)
        
        // Sell Stop Line (below gray box)
        sellStopLine = line.new(x1=leftBar, y1=sellStop, x2=rightBar, y2=sellStop,
                                xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=dashedLineColor, 
                                width=dashedLineWidth, style=line.style_dashed)
        array.push(sellStopLines, sellStopLine)
        
        // Labels on dashed lines
        if showLabels
            buyStopLabel = label.new(x=bar_index, y=buyStop, 
                                    text="Buy Stop " + str.tostring(math.round(buyStop)),
                                    style=label.style_none, 
                                    textcolor=tpLineColorUp, 
                                    size=getLabelSize(labelSize),
                                    textalign=text.align_center)
            array.push(buyStopLabels, buyStopLabel)
            
            sellStopLabel = label.new(x=bar_index, y=sellStop, 
                                     text="Sell Stop " + str.tostring(math.round(sellStop)),
                                     style=label.style_none, 
                                     textcolor=tpLineColorDn, 
                                     size=getLabelSize(labelSize),
                                     textalign=text.align_center)
            array.push(sellStopLabels, sellStopLabel)
    
    // ========== TP LINES ==========
    if showTPZones
        // Calculate TP line positions
        tp1UpLevel = buyStop + stopToTPGap
        tp2UpLevel = tp1UpLevel + tpLineGap
        tp3UpLevel = tp2UpLevel + tpLineGap
        
        tp1DnLevel = sellStop - stopToTPGap
        tp2DnLevel = tp1DnLevel - tpLineGap
        tp3DnLevel = tp2DnLevel - tpLineGap
        
        // Create TP1 UP Line
        tp1UpLine = line.new(x1=leftBar, y1=tp1UpLevel, x2=rightBar, y2=tp1UpLevel,
                            xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=tpLineColorUp, 
                            width=tpLineWidth, style=line.style_dashed)
        array.push(tp1UpLines, tp1UpLine)
        
        if showLabels
            tp1UpLabel = label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp1UpLevel,
                                  text="TP1 " + str.tostring(math.round(tp1UpLevel)),
                                  style=label.style_none,
                                  textcolor=tpTextColor,
                                  size=getLabelSize(labelSize),
                                  textalign=text.align_center)
            array.push(tp1UpLabels, tp1UpLabel)
        
        // Create TP1 DOWN Line
        tp1DnLine = line.new(x1=leftBar, y1=tp1DnLevel, x2=rightBar, y2=tp1DnLevel,
                            xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=tpLineColorDn, 
                            width=tpLineWidth, style=line.style_dashed)
        array.push(tp1DnLines, tp1DnLine)
        
        if showLabels
            tp1DnLabel = label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp1DnLevel,
                                  text="TP1 " + str.tostring(math.round(tp1DnLevel)),
                                  style=label.style_none,
                                  textcolor=tpTextColor,
                                  size=getLabelSize(labelSize),
                                  textalign=text.align_center)
            array.push(tp1DnLabels, tp1DnLabel)
        
        // Create TP2 UP Line
        tp2UpLine = line.new(x1=leftBar, y1=tp2UpLevel, x2=rightBar, y2=tp2UpLevel,
                            xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=tpLineColorUp, 
                            width=tpLineWidth, style=line.style_dashed)
        array.push(tp2UpLines, tp2UpLine)
        
        if showLabels
            tp2UpLabel = label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp2UpLevel,
                                  text="TP2 " + str.tostring(math.round(tp2UpLevel)),
                                  style=label.style_none,
                                  textcolor=tpTextColor,
                                  size=getLabelSize(labelSize),
                                  textalign=text.align_center)
            array.push(tp2UpLabels, tp2UpLabel)
        
        // Create TP2 DOWN Line
        tp2DnLine = line.new(x1=leftBar, y1=tp2DnLevel, x2=rightBar, y2=tp2DnLevel,
                            xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=tpLineColorDn, 
                            width=tpLineWidth, style=line.style_dashed)
        array.push(tp2DnLines, tp2DnLine)
        
        if showLabels
            tp2DnLabel = label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp2DnLevel,
                                  text="TP2 " + str.tostring(math.round(tp2DnLevel)),
                                  style=label.style_none,
                                  textcolor=tpTextColor,
                                  size=getLabelSize(labelSize),
                                  textalign=text.align_center)
            array.push(tp2DnLabels, tp2DnLabel)
        
        // Create TP3 UP Line
        tp3UpLine = line.new(x1=leftBar, y1=tp3UpLevel, x2=rightBar, y2=tp3UpLevel,
                            xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=tpLineColorUp, 
                            width=tpLineWidth, style=line.style_dashed)
        array.push(tp3UpLines, tp3UpLine)
        
        if showLabels
            tp3UpLabel = label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp3UpLevel,
                                  text="TP3 " + str.tostring(math.round(tp3UpLevel)),
                                  style=label.style_none,
                                  textcolor=tpTextColor,
                                  size=getLabelSize(labelSize),
                                  textalign=text.align_center)
            array.push(tp3UpLabels, tp3UpLabel)
        
        // Create TP3 DOWN Line
        tp3DnLine = line.new(x1=leftBar, y1=tp3DnLevel, x2=rightBar, y2=tp3DnLevel,
                            xloc=xloc.bar_index, color=tpLineColorDn, 
                            width=tpLineWidth, style=line.style_dashed)
        array.push(tp3DnLines, tp3DnLine)
        
        if showLabels
            tp3DnLabel = label.new(x=bar_index, y=tp3DnLevel,
                                  text="TP3 " + str.tostring(math.round(tp3DnLevel)),
                                  style=label.style_none,
                                  textcolor=tpTextColor,
                                  size=getLabelSize(labelSize),
                                  textalign=text.align_center)
            array.push(tp3DnLabels, tp3DnLabel)

// ==================== ALERTS ====================
// Track the most recent Buy Stop and Sell Stop levels
var float latestBuyStop = na
var float latestSellStop = na

// Update latest levels when new zones are created
if shouldTrigger
    latestBuyStop := buyStop
    latestSellStop := sellStop

// Calculate crossover/crossunder on every bar (outside conditional)
crossoverBuyStop = ta.crossover(close, latestBuyStop)
crossunderSellStop = ta.crossunder(close, latestSellStop)

// Alert conditions
buyStopAlert = enableAlerts and not na(latestBuyStop) and crossoverBuyStop
sellStopAlert = enableAlerts and not na(latestSellStop) and crossunderSellStop

// Trigger alerts
if buyStopAlert
    alert("BUY STOP: Price closed above " + str.tostring(latestBuyStop), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

if sellStopAlert
    alert("SELL STOP: Price closed below " + str.tostring(latestSellStop), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
